## Overview

MarkdStage v2.4.0 reorganizes the Canvas controls around a compact navigation bar and purpose-based
control panels without removing features. It also adds complete keyboard, focus, dismissal,
empty-deck, and accessibility coverage for the new interaction model.

The MarkdStage Skill and CLI documentation now provide a consistent create-review-deliver workflow:
read targeted guidance, validate the source, author in watch mode, inspect fixed 16:9 output, capture
only slides that need visual review, and deliver from the same Markdown source.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks, CLI commands, and
installation paths. Less frequently used Canvas actions now appear under **More controls** and its
purpose-based panels; previous/next navigation, page status, and the slide list remain directly
available.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v2.4.0`. |
| Canvas controls | Use **More controls** for editing, presenting, previewing, Markdown loading, and export actions. |
| CLI authoring | Existing commands are unchanged; follow the documented validate, watch, inspect, targeted capture, and delivery sequence. |
